presets.name: research-build
presets.description: One agent researches the web and X, a second builds from what it found, and a third checks the result.
presets.chain: Grok research → Claude build → ChatGPT check

presets.name: collab
presets.description: Two agents work as a pair: one plans, the other improves the plan, the first does the work, and the second edits and checks it.
presets.chain: Claude plan → ChatGPT amend → Claude build → ChatGPT edit (check)

presets.name: versus
presets.description: Two agents each build their own answer from the task alone and review each other's, then you pick the winner.
presets.chain: Claude build → ChatGPT build → ChatGPT review → Claude review → your pick

presets.name: redteam
presets.description: One agent builds, two others attack it on their own, the builder fixes what they found, and a checker confirms the fixes.
presets.chain: Claude build → ChatGPT attack → Cursor attack → Claude revise → ChatGPT check

presets.name: vote
presets.description: Three agents answer the same short question on their own; the majority wins, and a tie comes to you.
presets.chain: Claude vote → ChatGPT vote → Grok vote → tally

split.description: Claude breaks the task into 2 to 4 pieces, each with its own team; you approve the plan; the pieces run one at a time; Claude joins the results and ChatGPT checks the whole.
split.chain: Claude plan → your approval → the pieces, one at a time → Claude join → ChatGPT check

teams.name: route
teams.description: Jev labels the task; the skill table picks who does it and who checks it.
teams.chain: Jev's label → the skill table's doer → its checker

teams.name: research-build

plan.chain: Claude plan → ChatGPT attack → Cursor attack → Claude revise → ChatGPT check

skills.description: Find out what people on X (Twitter) are saying right now: sentiment, breaking news, memecoin chatter.
Find trends or posts on Instagram, Threads or Facebook.
Describe or pull information out of an image, screenshot or video that the task provides.
Look up facts on the open web or check whether a claim is true, with source links. Not social media chatter.
skills.not_for: Questions that can be answered from general knowledge with no lookup, such as math, unit conversions or definitions.

skills.description: Write, fix or explain code, bots or scripts.
Write, edit or translate text for people to read: copy, newsletters, posts, docs.
Break a goal into steps or split a big task into smaller tasks, without doing the steps.
Carry out actions in a browser or on a computer: click, fill in forms, log in, navigate a site.
Create a new image or video.
Apply the same simple step to many items: tag, sort or summarize a large batch of posts or rows.
Answer a simple question from general knowledge: math, unit conversions, definitions.
skills.not_for: Anything that needs today's facts, prices, dates or a source link.

skills.description: Answer a question about earlier tasks in the same project or chat from what the router remembers: what was done, decided, produced or said, or what was planned next. The answer reports; it makes nothing new.
skills.not_for: Any task that produces something, even from an earlier result or 'from memory': writing, rewriting, shortening or redoing a text, planning, code, or anything needing new facts from the web or social media.
